body:
Adds `research/deadband-twin`: a linear actuator twin fitted by least squares to a deadband actuator recovers exactly `g·P(|z|>δ/s)`, looks well fitted (R² 0.89, residual uncorrelated with input), but the gain does not transfer across excitation scales. Includes feedforward dead-zone results, the exact `δ/k` closed-loop stall band, and a (g, δ) fit as repair.

- 6 unit tests pass; `experiments/results.txt` is generated by `experiments/run.py`.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
- Stylised, simulated "real" system; builds on ARPG / IRT / HIRO directions without affiliation or endorsement.
